title: Regional reservations launch binder — Singapore (G12) & flexible-commit SKUs
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a single-source "binders" (launch binder) for the Singapore G12 instance family + flexible reservation SKUs. This ticket consolidates the cross-team checklist, final release notes copy, billing/SKU mapping, runbook snippets, and rollback criteria so support, sales, and infra can operate from one document during the soft launch.

Scope:
- Launch dedicated capacity in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) for the new G12 instance family.
- Introduce two reservation SKUs: Flexible-Commit (monthly rolling) and Standard-Commit (1yr).
- Coordinate release notes, billing system entries, and console SKU display.

Out-of-scope: global marketing creative, downstream partner marketplace listings (handled by partner ops).
acceptance_criteria: Console displays G12 SKUs with correct price bands and commit options in ap-southeast-1
Billing entries created and validated end-to-end for both Flexible-Commit and Standard-Commit SKUs
Support runbook available in Confluence and linked from the Console ‘Help’ modal
Release notes copy approved by legal + compliance and staged for 2026-04.15 release
Canary test traffic runs in ap-southeast-1 with baseline latency and cost telemetry within target ranges

rollout_steps: 1) Finalize SKU & price bands in the SKU spreadsheet and lock billing tokens
2) Push staging entries to billing sandbox and validate invoice generation
3) Deploy Console copy + SKU selectors to staging and run UI smoke tests
4) Run runtime canary in ap-southeast-1 with 1% traffic for 48h, monitor latency/cost SLOs
5) Gradual ramp to 10% over next 24h if canary passes; monitor error rates and fallback routes
6) Publish release notes to docs and schedule customer-facing announcement (email + dashboard banner)
7) Open support war room for the first 72h of GA and track incidents in PagerDuty
release_notes_draft: New: Dedicated G12 instance family (ap-southeast-1) — higher throughput for batch and low-latency chat workloads.
New: Flexible-Commit reservations — monthly rolling reservations that reduce commit friction for seasonal workloads.
Improved: Console shows per-SKU cost estimate and projected monthly savings when applying reservations.
Notes: Initial launch limited to ap-southeast-1; additional regions will follow. Contact sales for enterprise commitments.
cross_team_actions: Design: Provide final screenshots and microcopy for pricing modal — link to staged builds
Engineering: Expose SKU IDs and pricing API for Console and Billing — provide swagger contract
Finance: Validate revenue recognition treatment for Flexible-Commit
SRE: Create dashboard with token-level cost, latency percentile, and reservation attach rate
Support: Prepare FAQ and train L1 for reservation swap requests
risks: Billing mismatch causes incorrect invoices for first wave of customers
Runtime autoscale settings insufficient for initial demand spike, causing elevated latency
Console mis-labels commit term causing confusion and increased support load
Legal flags in release notes delay public announcement
mitigations: Run 3x invoice permutations in billing sandbox with realistic customer profiles before GA
Hold a contingency pool of reserved GPUs for 48h post-GA and enable manual burst if autoscale lags
Add explicit commit-duration tooltip and require confirmation modal for purchasing reservations
Route release notes through legal early (done) and have alternate copy prepared if edits needed
